{{Quote|Fortunate, tragic Sanrafsix sits at the intersection of the Duros Space Run and the eponymous Sanrafsix Corridor.|A cartographical survey and field report by Vannar Treece|<ref name="Gazetter" />}}
'''Sanrafsix''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. Situated on the [[Duros Space Run]] and [[Sanrafsix Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]], during the [[New Sith Wars]] Sanrafsix was a cosmopolitan [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] hub, a fact which doomed the world when it could not maintain quarantine during a [[Candorian plague/Legends|Candorian plague]] outbreak and was forced to isolate its groundside population, all of whom eventually succumbed to the [[Death/Legends|lethal]] [[Disease/Legends|disease]].

[[Standard decade/Legends|Decades]] later, Sanrafsix was the site of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Battle of Sanrafsix (New Sith Wars)|victory]] over the forces of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Later a part of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and then the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], eventually Sanrafsix fell under the control of the Imperial splinter faction [[Eriadu Authority]], and during a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Battle of Sanrafsix (Galactic Civil War)|assault]] there in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the famed [[TIE pilot|Imperial pilot]] [[Shea Hublin]] fell in combat.

==Description==
Sanrafsix was a terrestrial<ref name="Gazetter" /> [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="AoR">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> located in the [[Sanrafsix system/Legends|Sanrafsix system]],<ref name="TEA" /> a part of the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]<ref name="Gazetter" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> Sanrafsix was situated at the intersection of the [[Duros Space Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which connected it to the [[Aplooine system/Legends|Aplooine]] and [[Heptooine system/Legends|Heptooine systems]], and the [[Sanrafsix Corridor]], which linked it to the [[Fostin system/Legends|Fostin system]].<ref name="Gazetter" />

==History==
===A doomed world===
{{Quote|The orbital stations of Sanrafsix are presumably still in business, though which Sith Lord holds sway here is a matter of debate.|A cartographical survey and field report by Vannar Treece|<ref name="Gazetter" />}}
[[File:Battle_of_Sanrafsix_New_Sith_Wars.jpg|thumb|left|250px|During the New Sith Wars, the Jedi were victorious over the Sith at Sanrafsix.]]
[[Realspace/Legends|Space]] surrounding Sanrafsix was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]] and [[8000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> and the world had become a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" /> During the [[Republic Dark Age|last century]] of the [[New Sith Wars]], which were fought between [[2000 BBY/Legends|2000 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the [[Candorian plague/Legends|Candorian plague]] swept through the Republic's territory.<ref name="TEA" /> Sanrafsix was unsuccessful at maintaining a quarantine during the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the outbreak and as a result isolated the population of its surface, condemning those inhabitants to inevitable [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Gazetter" />

In a [[Astrography|cartographical]] survey and field report on the Grumani [[Sector/Legends|sector]] compiled<ref name="Gazetter" /> by [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-knight-errant-gazetter|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The Knight Errant Gazetteer|int=The Knight Errant Gazetteer}} is presented as an [[in-universe]] [[Astrography|cartographical]] survey and field report compiled shortly before the [[Raid on Oranessan|commencement]] of [[Operation Influx]], which {{SWArchive|url=vault/books/knighterrant_influx/index.html|text=''Star Wars: Knight Errant: Influx''|int=Star Wars: Knight Errant: Influx}} dates to [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vannar Treece]] noted the history of Sanrafsix, which<ref name="Gazetter" /> he<ref name="Influx">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/knighterrant_influx/index.html|text=''Star Wars: Knight Errant: Influx''|int=Star Wars: Knight Errant: Influx}}</ref> characterized as both fortunate and tragic. Treece also speculated that the [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Space station/Legends|stations]] circling the world were still operational but noted that it was not clear to the Republic which [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] held control over Sanrafsix at the [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="Gazetter" /> Between [[1004 BBY]] and 1000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], Sanrafsix was situated in territory held by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and was the site of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Battle of Sanrafsix (New Sith Wars)|victory]] at some point during that period.<ref name="TEA" />

===Following the Sith wars===
{{Quote|Eriadu endures.|The last words of Shea Hublin, uttered during a battle at Sanrafsix|<ref name="EGTW" />}}
[[File:SheaHublin_ENS.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The famed pilot Shea Hublin fell in battle at Sanrafsix.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Sanrafsix fell within the borders of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="TEA" /> with the Republic's [[Fifteenth Army|Fifteenth Sector Army]] being charged with engaging the Confederacy's [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] in the world's vicinity during the first campaigns of that conflict. By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Sanrafsix was a part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGTW" /> Due to Sanrafsix's location on strategic [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes, [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Rebel Alliance Intelligence]] established an [[Watercrest Outpost|outpost]] on the nearby [[Mayagil sector/Legends|Mayagil sector]] world [[Reyniu]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AoR" />

When the Empire began to fragment following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Sanrafsix was incorporated into the territory claimed by the [[Eriadu Authority]],<ref name="TEA" /> the Imperial splinter faction of the self-styled [[Superior General]] [[Sander Delvardus]].<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-2|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> Late in the [[5 ABY/Legends|following year]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] launched a merciless [[Battle of Sanrafsix (Galactic Civil War)|assault]] at Sanrafsix.<ref name="TEA" /> During that battle, the famed [[TIE pilot|Imperial pilot]] [[Shea Hublin]] died in combat against a [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] of enemy [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|starfighters]],<ref name="EGTW" /> and the borders of the Eriadu Authority were reduced as a result of the confrontation.<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|Because this hub of trade and cosmopolitan cultural exchange could not maintain quarantine during the first year of the Candorian outbreak, it ultimately isolated its groundside population to inevitable death.|A cartographical survey and field report by Vannar Treece|<ref name="Gazetter" />}}
By the time of the New Sith Wars, Sanrafsix was a cosmopolitan hub of [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] and cultural exchange, but those traits proved its undoing when the world's surface population was wiped out by the Candorian plague.<ref name="Gazetter" /> Sanrafsix was known for<ref name="AoR" /> its notable [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-[[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] system<ref name="TEA" /> during the Galactic Civil War,<ref name="AoR" /> and the world's population around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered between ten and one hundred million.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sanrafsix was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-17.<ref name="TEA" />
